question.text: Which of the following sets are components of the NPO's 'Disclosures on General aspects' under the annual 60-day pack?

answer.text: Name (legal and popular); Location of headquarters and operations; Vision/Mission/Purpose; Organizational goals, activities, products and services; Scale of operations (incl. Employee and Volunteer strength).
Board members' ages; Compensation ratios; Gender pay gap; Auditor rotation plan.
Related-party transactions; Statement of compliance; Auditor details.
Credit rating; Debt service coverage ratio; Asset cover; Maturity profile.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Under 91(C)(2) 'General aspects' within 60 days of FY-end include: Name, Location, Vision/Mission/Purpose, Organizational goals/activities/products/services, Scale of operations including Employee and Volunteer strength. **The Trap:** Option B items are governance topics not listed in the General-aspects set. Option C items are Governance / Financial annual disclosures (Oct-31 pack). Option D is an instrument-disclosure set under different regulations. **Cross-Exam Context:** The PDF chapter's sample Q1 tests exactly this mapping; XXIII candidates should cross-read the workbook's sample questions. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Build a SIA intake checklist that groups NPO disclosures into General / Governance / Financial buckets per 91(C). Doing this at the scoping stage prevents the SE from running two separate information requests for the same annual cycle.
